verdict.rationale: Keycloak's own docs say it can authenticate users with existing OpenID Connect or SAML 2.0 identity providers, configured through the admin console. Hands-on reports confirm production use with many external IdPs, and one notes Google SSO took only a few settings. missing for 10: named Okta and Entra ID integration guides, in-depth brokering configuration docs (attribute/claim mappers, first-login flow) in the evidence.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can connect enterprise identity providers over SAML and OIDC (Okta, Entra, Google Workspace) for workforce sign-in

citations.quote: Keycloak can also authenticate users with existing OpenID Connect or SAML 2.0 Identity Providers. Again, this is just a matter of configuring the Identity Provider through the admin console.
integrated a lot of external IdP's to offer proper SSO on multiple of our software stacks
Google SSO was a few settings away
